title: What is Mukesh Ambani's Strategy to beat Coke with Campa Cola? | Business Case Study

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Mukesh Ambani ne apni Campa Cola ke sath ek bahut bada daav khela hai—200 crore rupaye dekar campa cola ab IPL ka co-presenting partners ban chuka hai! Aur iske saath hi Reliance ne Bharat ke soft drink market mein ek aisa yuddh chhed diya hai jisme Coca-Cola aur Pepsi jaise do bade giants ko seedhi takkar milegi!
Ye itni badi baat isliye hai,
Doston, kyuki pichle 30 saalon se Coca-Cola aur Pepsi ne Bharat ke soft drink market par 80% se bhi zyada control banaya hua hai. In dono giants ne apne saamne kisi bhi bharatiya brand ko tikne hi nahi diya. Pehle inhone sarkar ke "Double Seven" brand ko market se hataya, phir Parle ke mashhoor Gold Spot ko band karwaya, aur Rasna jaise super-hit brand ko bhi majboor kar diya ki woh market se peeche hat jaaye. Infact, khud Campa Cola bhi Coke aur Pepsi ke bharat aane ke baad market mein fail ho gaya tha!
Sochiye—Parle, Govt. of India, Campa Cola aur Rasna—sabhi ko Coca-Cola aur Pepsi ke saamne haar ka saamna karna pada!
Aakhir Coke aur Pepsi ke paas asia kya hai jo unhe unbeatable banata hai? Unke paas duniya bhar ka paisa hai, soft drink industry mein 100 saalon se bhi zyada ka tajurba hai, lakhon retail outlets ki strong distribution hai aur duniya ki sabse zabardast marketing teams hain! Bharat mein unke customers itne loyal hain ki agar aap kisi se bhi poochh lein ki cold drink kaunsi piyoge, toh jawab hamesha Coke ya Pepsi ya unke kisi sub-brand ka hi hoga—koi bhi Campa Cola nahi bolega!
Aur agar hum Reliance ki taraf dekhein, toh unke paas soft drink industry mein experience zero hai! Aur sabse badi baat—wo ek aise brand ko revive karne ki koshish kar rahe hain jo already Bharat mein ek baar fail ho chuka hai! 
Toh sawaal utta hai:
Reliance ek failed brand, Campa Cola ko revive karke kya karna chahta hai?
Market mein already Coke aur Pepsi ke hote hue, kya sach mein ek aur soft drink ki zarurat hai?
Aakhir Mukesh Bhai aur unki team ki aisi kaunsi strategies hain jinse wo Coca-Cola aur Pepsi jaisi giant brands ko challenge kr rahe hai?
Aur is poore business case study se hum kya seekh sakte hain?
In sab sawaalon ka jawab jaanne ke liye, jude rahiye hamare saath iss episode mein!
